page_title: RMA 4-1 VIL | Real Madrid v Villarreal 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The corner kick from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) steps up to send the ball in.

90+1' Joselu (Real Madrid) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Filip Jorgensen.
89' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is penalised for holding. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a set piece. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
88' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

88' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

86' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
85' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez had an easy-decision to make.
84' PENALTY APPEAL by Villarreal, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
84' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Brahim Diaz is replaced by Joselu (Real Madrid).
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
79' Substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) replaces Jose Luis Morales.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) coming on for Toni Kroos.
78' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) replaces Jude Bellingham.
78' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
77' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) works the corner short.
76' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' A substitution has been made. Ilias Akhomach goes off and Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) comes on.
74' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

72' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Filip Jorgensen comes off the line to clear the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
68' 4 - 1 Goal! Luka Modric (Real Madrid) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:1.
68' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
67' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Adria Altimira (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
67' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
66' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez who sees an offensive foul.

64' 3 - 1 Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Filip Jorgensen is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 3:1.
63' What a chance! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.
63' The corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared away by the defence.
62' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
61' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
59' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
57' The ball is crossed into the box and Rodrygo (Real Madrid) reacts quickest to send a shot flying low towards the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen gets a glove on it to thwart him.

54' 2 - 1 Goal! Ramon Terrats produces a great pass that finds Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
54' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
53' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
53' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
53' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Now Real Madrid have a corner.
52' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
51' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows the whistle, Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
50' The attendance is 70500.

47' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Filip Jorgensen blocks the shot with his legs.
46' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is being substituted because of an injury. Marcelino sends Alexander Sorloth on the pitch.
46' Here is a change. Raul Albiol is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal).
46' Ferland Mendy will be replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
45+2' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
40' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) jumps into a tackle and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a foul.
39' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals that the goal stands! The Real Madrid players celebrate.
37' Real Madrid score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
37' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
37' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will deliver the corner kick.

37' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Real Madrid earn a corner.
35' Problems for Carlo Ancelotti as David Alaba is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) replaces him.
33' The game is interrupted. David Alaba (Real Madrid) suffers a horrific injury!
32' Foul! Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
32' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for an infringement.
29' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Alex Baena leaves the pitch to be replaced by Ramon Terrats (Villarreal).
27' The injury to Alex Baena (Villarreal) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.

25' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Luka Modric and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Filip Jorgensen was helpless.

23' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Luka Modric (Real Madrid) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
19' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Filip Jorgensen, who pulls off a stunning save!
17' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.
17' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.

16' Great solo effort from Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
15' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

14' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the right side of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. Real Madrid have a corner.

12' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid). Jorge Figueroa Vazquez saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Villarreal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
9' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul after Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) hacks down one of his opponents.
9' He should have scored! Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
6' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes it short.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
6' Villarreal concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
4' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) trips an opposition player and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a foul.

3' A short pass finds Federico Valverde (Real Madrid). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
3' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

3' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
